name: Kuva Bramma — One-Shot Steel Path
playstyle: Aim above packs, not at them — bomblets rain down. Slower than the Zarr per shot but each shot covers a huge area.

description: Charge the Incarnon form and it becomes a hitscan delete beam. One of the hardest-hitting primaries in the game once transformed.
name: Phenmor — One-Shot Steel Path (Incarnon)
playstyle: Get headshot kills in normal form to charge Incarnon, then transform and hold the beam on priority targets. Melts Acolytes and Archons.

description: A wall of plasma per shot. Huge damage per trigger pull with innate punch-through — point it at a hallway and everything dies.

mods.name: Toxic Barrage
mods.note: Toxin 60/60 — status chance + the Viral half.

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on the big crits

name: Tenet Arca Plasmor — Strong All-Rounder
playstyle: One wide plasma wave per shot — aim center-mass down corridors. Radiation or Viral depending on progenitor and faction.

description: Builds charges on kill, then the Incarnon form fires devastating void beams. Arguably the best secondary in the game for Steel Path.
name: Laetum — One-Shot Steel Path (Incarnon Pistol)
playstyle: Farm a few kills to charge Incarnon, transform, and beam down everything. The alt-fire radial blast handles crowds.

description: Chains microwave beams across enemies stacking tons of statuses. The best primer in the game — paint a pack with statuses, then one-tap them with your primary or melee.
name: Kuva Nukor — Status Primer / Strong Secondary
playstyle: Sweep the beam across a pack for 1-2 seconds, then swap to your main weapon. With 4+ status types stacked, Galvanized mods and Condition Overload go crazy.

description: Throw it, detonate mid-air, watch the map explode. Heavy-attack thrown detonations scale insanely and one-shot Steel Path packs.

mods.name: Amalgam Organ Shatter
mods.note: Crit damage + heavy attack wind-up speed

name: Glaive Prime — One-Shot Heavy Attack
playstyle: Heavy-attack throw into packs and manually detonate. Build combo counter first on stragglers for maximum Blood Rush scaling.

description: Mesmer Skin makes you literally unkillable while charges last. The easiest frame to take into hard Steel Path content — press 2 and walk forward.

mods.name: Blind Rage
mods.note: Power strength for Mesmer Skin charges

name: Revenant — Unkillable Steel Path Frame
playstyle: Keep Mesmer Skin (2) up at all times — recast when charges run low. Enthrall (1) + Reave (3) deletes thralls for energy and health.

description: Spores + Toxic Lash spread viral/toxin across the whole map. The fastest Steel Path clearer for exterminate and survival farms.
name: Saryn — Room Nuke (Steel Path Farm Queen)
playstyle: Cast Spores (1) on an enemy, pop it with Toxic Lash (3)-buffed weapon, watch spores spread. Keep Miasma (4) for burst. Recast spores before they fall off.

description: Defy gives you 3 free deaths per cast and your Celestial Twin doubles your damage. The comfiest frame for almost any content.
name: Wukong — Lazy Immortal (Strong General)
playstyle: Keep the Twin (1) summoned, Defy (3) ready for its free revives, Cloud Walker (2) to skip anything annoying. The Twin uses your primary — give it your best weapon.

description: Iron Skin makes you immune to damage and knockdown. The classic recommendation for new players pushing through the star chart into Steel Path.

mods.name: Ironclad Charge
mods.note: Augment — Iron Skin scales with enemies hit

name: Rhino — Best Starter Tank (Strong General)
playstyle: Charge (1) through a pack, cast Iron Skin (2) — now you're immune. Roar (3) buffs your whole squad's damage. Stomp (4) for crowd control.

description: Cordon yanks every enemy within 30m into one tight ball every 15s — shoot the ball once with your Zarr/Bramma and the whole pack dies.
name: Nautilus Prime — Best Sentinel for AoE Builds
playstyle: Let Cordon group packs, then delete them with AoE. The bond mods buff your fire rate and crit damage passively.
weaponNote: Equip Verglas Prime with a status build — its statuses feed Manifold Bond.

name: Rhino — Unkillable Starter Tank
description: Press 2 (Iron Skin) and walk through the star chart like nothing can touch you. The single best frame for learning the game.
playstyle: Cast Iron Skin (2) whenever it breaks, charge (1) through crowds for fun, stomp (4) when surrounded. You are the wall — your team will love you.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: More health to feed Iron Skin

name: Excalibur — Exalted Blade Starter
description: Your starter frame's ultimate turns him into a melee god. Cheap mods, huge damage, zero fuss.
playstyle: Build energy, press 4 (Exalted Blade), and swing. Radial Blind (2) stuns rooms when you need breathing room.

mods.name: Flow
mods.note: Energy to keep the blade out

mods.name: Steel Fiber
mods.note: You will be in melee range

name: Volt — Speed Demon Starter
description: Run fast, hit hard, shield up. Volt's kit teaches you everything about ability synergy.
playstyle: Drop Electric Shield (3), shoot through it for bonus damage. Speed (2) to zoom, Shock (1) to stun. Discharge (4) clears rooms.

name: Mag — Magnetize Starter
description: One of the starter frames with a trick that scales forever: Magnetize turns enemy bullets into a blender.
playstyle: Cast Magnetize (2) on a tough enemy, shoot into the bubble. Pull (1) groups crowds into it. Crush (4) strips armor.

name: Oberon — Starter Healer
description: The paladin frame. Heal your squad, strip armor, and never die. Everyone wants an Oberon on defense missions.
playstyle: Keep Renewal (3) running, stand on Hallowed Ground (2) for bonus armor, Reckoning (4) strips armor off everything.

mods.name: Phoenix Renewal
mods.note: Cheat death once per while — Oberon augment

name: Frost — Defense Wall Starter
description: The defense mission king. Drop a Snow Globe and the objective is safe. Simple, effective, always wanted.
playstyle: Snow Globe (3) on the objective, Avalanche (4) to freeze and strip armor. Freeze (1) for single targets.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: You stand in the open a lot

name: Ember — Fire Starter
description: Set the world on fire. Ember's kit is pure damage and it feels amazing on early star chart missions.
playstyle: Inferno (4) rains meteors, Fire Blast (2) strips armor, keep moving and everything burns.

name: Trinity — Energy Battery Starter
description: The support every squad wants. Infinite energy for the team and you literally cannot die.
playstyle: Energy Vampire (2) on enemies for team energy, Blessing (4) for full heal + damage resist, Link (3) to stay alive.

name: Loki — Stealth Starter
description: Go invisible and walk past everything. The spy-mission king and the fastest way to learn the game solo.
playstyle: Invisibility (2) always on, Decoy (1) to distract, Radial Disarm (4) to neuter gun enemies. Hack consoles in peace.

name: Boltor — Starter Rifle
description: The workhorse rifle that carries new players through the star chart. Nails enemies to walls. Literally.
playstyle: Aim for the torso, hold trigger. The innate punch-through and ragdoll keep crowds controlled.

mods.name: Infected Clip
mods.note: Toxin — the other half of Viral/Corrosive

name: Hek — Shotgun Room Clearer
description: Four barrels of 'no'. The Hek deletes everything on the early star chart and its augment makes it scale further.
playstyle: Get close, aim center-mass, delete. Scattered Justice augment adds multishot and a justice proc.

mods.name: Frigid Blast
mods.note: Cold — the other half of Viral

name: Karak — Reliable Auto Rifle
description: The Grineer rifle that just works. Accurate, hard-hitting, and easy to mod for any faction.
playstyle: Burst-fire at range, full-auto up close. Swap elements per faction with the 60/60 mods.

name: Atomos — Chain Beam Starter
description: A beam that chains between enemies. Point at a crowd and watch it melt. One of the best early secondaries.
playstyle: Hold trigger, sweep across groups. The chain does the aiming for you.

name: Lex — Pocket Sniper Starter
description: A hand cannon with sniper accuracy. One shot, one kill through most of the star chart.
playstyle: Aim for heads, fire slow and deliberate. Pairs perfectly with a fast primary.

name: Skana — First Sword Starter
description: Your first real sword. Fast, simple, and with the right mods it stays relevant way longer than it should.
playstyle: Spam melee, use slam attacks (jump + melee) for crowds. Keep combo counter up.

name: Bo — Long Staff Starter
description: Huge range for a starter weapon. You hit enemies before they can touch you.
playstyle: Keep distance, sweep wide arcs. The range is the whole point — abuse it.

name: Revenant — Mesmer Skin God Mode
description: The closest thing to immortality in Warframe. Mesmer Skin shrugs off hits that would one-shot anything else. Your frame, your rules.
playstyle: Keep Mesmer Skin (2) up — recast when charges run low. Enthrall (1) spreads, Reave (3) deletes thralls for massive damage. Danse Macabre (4) for crowds.

name: Saryn — Spore Nuke Steel Path
description: Infect the whole map and watch the kill counter explode. The premier Steel Path farmer and nuke frame.
playstyle: Cast Spores (1) on an enemy, pop it with a weapon to spread. Toxic Lash (3) for weapon damage, Miasma (4) to detonate everything.

mods.name: Regenerative Molt
mods.note: Heal on Molt cast — Saryn augment

name: Wukong — Celestial Twin Steel Path
description: Your twin does double damage while you literally cannot die. The laziest strong build in the game.
playstyle: Summon Celestial Twin (1), give it your best weapon, go invisible with Cloud Walker (2) and let the twin murder everything. Defy (3) for armor.

name: Mesa — Peacemaker Steel Path
description: The gunslinger. Peacemaker auto-aims and deletes Steel Path enemies faster than you can blink.
playstyle: Shooting Gallery (2) for damage, Shatter Shield (3) for 95% damage reduction, Peacemaker (4) to erase rooms. Keep regulators modded for crit.

mods.name: Mesa's Waltz
mods.note: Move while in Peacemaker — Mesa augment

name: Nekros — Desecrate Loot Farmer
description: Double the loot from every corpse. The frame you bring when you want twice the resources, mods, and parts.
playstyle: Keep Desecrate (3) always on — it re-rolls every corpse for extra drops. Terrify (2) for crowd control, Shadows (4) for meat shields.

mods.name: Despoil
mods.note: Desecrate costs health instead of energy — Nekros augment, the whole build

mods.name: Shield Of Shadows
mods.note: Damage reduction per shadow — Nekros augment

name: Khora — Pilfering Strangledome Farmer
description: Strangle the room, loot it twice. Khora's augment turns her CC into a farming machine that also shreds Steel Path.
playstyle: Strangledome (4) on spawns, Whipclaw (1) with the augment to execute. Venari heals you. Double loot from everything caught.

mods.name: Pilfering Strangledome
mods.note: Enemies in the dome drop extra loot — Khora augment

name: Volt — Eidolon Hunter

playstyle: Drop shields (3) for your amp DPS, Speed (2) to reposition, Shock (1) to break limbs. Coordinate with your squad's DPS.

mods.name: Capacitance
mods.note: Shields for the squad on Discharge — Volt augment

name: Chroma — Eidolon DPS
description: The big-number frame. Vex Armor multiplies your damage into the millions for Eidolon limb breaks.
playstyle: Take damage to charge Vex Armor (3), pop Elemental Ward (2) for heat, then dump everything into the limb. Time it with Volt shields.

mods.name: Vitality
mods.note: You need to TAKE damage safely

name: Mirage — Sanctuary Onslaught Nuker
description: Prism + Hall of Mirrors turns every room into a laser light show. Elite Onslaught speed-clearer.
playstyle: Hall of Mirrors (1), Eclipse (3) for damage, Prism (4) to nuke. Keep moving — the zone timer is always ticking.

mods.name: Total Eclipse
mods.note: Share Eclipse with squad — Mirage augment

name: Titania — Archon Hunt Shredder
description: Shrink down, fly fast, and melt Archons with Dex Pixia. The Archon hunt speedrun frame.
playstyle: Razorwing (4) for tiny mode, Dex Pixia shreds bosses. Spellbind (1) for status immunity, Tribute (2) for buffs.

mods.name: Aviator
mods.note: Damage reduction while airborne — made for Titania

name: Tenet Arca Plasmor — One-Shot Steel Path

mods.name: Chilling Reload
mods.note: Cold damage + reload speed — half of Viral

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — the one-shot engine

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — the one-shot engine

mods.name: Primed Ravage

mods.name: Hunter Munitions
mods.note: Slash procs on crits — armor irrelevant

mods.name: Galvanized Chamber
mods.note: WHY: Multishot — more bolts on tap-fire, more explosive instances on the alt-fire nuke.

mods.name: Cautious Shot

mods.name: Primed Bane Of Grineer
mods.note: WHY: Faction damage — a clean 55% multiplier on everything against Steel Path Grineer heavies.

name: Trumna Prime — One-Shot Steel Path
playstyle: Rack up kills with the primary to charge the alt-fire grenade — the assault rifle alone shreds packs with viral and slash. Once charged, lob the grenade into the next pack instead of fighting it; the explosion with full Hunter Munitions and viral support one-shots the room. Repeat the loop: primary charges, grenade deletes.

mods.name: Galvanized Hell

mods.name: Primed Bane Of Grineer

name: Phantasma Prime — One-Shot Steel Path

playstyle: Build combo, go Incarnon, heavy attack the biggest threat in the room.

name: Torid — Incarnon Beam
description: The beam that broke the meta. Viral + Hunter Munitions slash on a chaining beam melts Steel Path rooms.
playstyle: Charge Incarnon, sweep the beam across packs. Cold + toxin = Viral; slash procs ignore armor.

name: Bubonico — Arm Cannon
description: Shotgun-arm-cannon hybrid. Viral + slash in alt-fire mode turns hallways into kill zones.
playstyle: Primary fire for groups, alt-fire for single targets. Keep Hunter Munitions rolling for armor ignore.

name: Ignis Wraith — Corrosive Hose
description: Point, hold trigger, everything dies. Corrosive strips armor while heat keeps the damage ticking.
playstyle: Sweep the beam across crowds. Heat + toxin + electric gives you broad status coverage against everything.

name: Amprex — Chain Lightning
description: The original chain beam. Crit + corrosive arcs clear entire rooms from a single target.
playstyle: Shoot one enemy in a pack and let the arcs do the work. Tight corridors are your best friend.

name: Tenet Glaxion — Viral Beam
description: Freezes and shreds. Viral halves enemy health pools while slash procs finish armored targets.
playstyle: Hold the beam on heavies. Cold + toxin = Viral — the progenitor toxin does half the work for you.
progenitor: Toxin (combines with the cold mod for Viral)

name: Cedo — Status Primer
description: The best primer in the game. Glaive throws every status in the book, then the shotgun finishes primed targets.
playstyle: Throw the glaive into packs to stack statuses, then mop up with primary fire's bonus damage vs status'd enemies.

name: Dual Toxocyst — Incarnon Frenzy
description: Headshots turn it into a machine gun. Incarnon form with viral melts Steel Path at fire rates that break the game.
playstyle: Land headshots to trigger the frenzy, then hold trigger. Cold + toxin = Viral keeps everything soft.

name: Onos — Corrosive Beam
description: A pocket Amprex. Corrosive strips armor off Steel Path heavies while crits keep the numbers huge.
playstyle: Sweep across packs. Electric + toxin = Corrosive — armor stops mattering fast.

name: Kuva Nukor — Status Primer
description: Four statuses per trigger pull. Nothing primes a target faster — your other weapons do double duty after this.
playstyle: Paint priority targets with the beam, then swap to your main weapon for the kill. Magnetic progenitor adds a fifth status.

name: Epitaph — AoE Primer
description: Charged shots blanket rooms in status. The uncharged tap still hits like a truck for cleanup.
playstyle: Charge into packs for the AoE primer, tap-fire stragglers. Viral + heat + electric covers everything.

name: Kompressa — Viral Hose
description: Viral on tap with crit to back it up. One of the most comfortable Steel Path secondaries ever made.
playstyle: Hold trigger and sweep. Cold + toxin = Viral; Galvanized Shot rewards the status stacking.

name: Venka Prime — Combo Monster
description: The x13 combo multiplier turns every hit into a truck. Condition Overload scales it into Steel Path endgame.
playstyle: Build combo and never let it drop. Weeping Wounds + Condition Overload = more damage the longer you fight.

name: Sampotes — Incarnon Fists
description: Incarnon fists with combo scaling. Fast, brutal, and it keeps up with Steel Path scaling for a long time.
playstyle: Charge Incarnon early, keep the combo rolling. Punch through packs — the range surprises people.

name: Okina Prime — Incarnon Daggers
description: Dual daggers that scale forever. Combo + status + crit in one package that never falls off.
playstyle: Build combo on trash, spend it on heavies. Drifting Contact keeps your combo alive between packs.

name: Galatine Prime — Speed Crit
description: The classic greatsword, modernized. Crit + speed + range turns it into a Steel Path lawnmower.
playstyle: Spin through packs. Berserker Fury keeps you at max speed once crits start landing.

name: Kullervo — Melee God
description: Wrathful Advance teleports you to enemies with a guaranteed crit buff, and the strength stacking makes every melee swing a nuke.
playstyle: Cast Wrathful Advance, teleport-strike priority targets. Storm of Ukko groups enemies first for maximum carnage.

name: Dante — Noctua Support
description: The bard that keeps everyone alive. Overguard on demand, damage buffs, and enough strength to make it all count.
playstyle: Keep Triumph and Wordwarden cycling for the team. Build strength so your buffs and damage actually matter.

name: Jade — Glory Nuke
description: Light of Judgment rains judgment. Strength + range turns her 4 into a room-clearing nuke with team support baked in.
playstyle: Pop Glory of Judgment in big rooms, keep moving. The damage scales with strength — don't skimp on it.

name: Citrine — Crystal Support
description: Prisms, healing, and status immunity for the whole squad. The support frame that makes Steel Path feel fair.
playstyle: Keep Fractured Blast and Preserving Shell up. Strength makes your crystals hit harder and protect better.

name: Voruna — Stealth Melee
description: Invisible, fast, lethal. Lycath's Hunt keeps you cloaked while status-spread melee deletes packs.
playstyle: Stay invisible, spread status with melee, let the pack hunt itself. Strength feeds everything.

name: Styanax — Spear Nuke
description: Tharros Strike groups them, Axios Javelineers delete them. Strength + range = entire rooms gone in two casts.
playstyle: Group with Tharros Strike, nuke with spears. Keep energy flowing — this build is hungry.

name: Gyre — Electric Nuke
description: Cathode Grace turns every crit into an electric storm. Strength + range keeps the lightning rolling across Steel Path packs.
playstyle: Keep Cathode Grace active, crit everything. The electric procs chain through crowds on their own.

name: Qorvex — Radiation Tank
description: A walking reactor. Radiation status confuses enemies into killing each other while you stand in the middle of it all.
playstyle: Keep Containment Wall cycling, let radiation do the crowd control. Built to face-tank what it can't confuse.

name: Narin — Ability Nuke
description: Max strength and range to turn Narin's kit into a room-clearing nuke. Cast, watch everything melt.
playstyle: Keep energy up with Zenurik or Energy Nexus. Cast abilities in rotation — range does the work.

name: Koumei — Dice Roller Support
description: Duration and efficiency to keep Koumei's dice rolling. Buff the squad, debuff enemies, never stop casting.
playstyle: Roll dice on cooldown. High duration keeps buffs up; efficiency lets you spam without worry.

name: Temple — Riff Rocker
description: Strength-focused Temple that turns every riff into a stage-clearing blast. Loud, proud, deadly.
playstyle: Build your riff meter with weapon kills, then unleash. Strength scales the blast damage hard.

name: Oraxia — Silent Assassin
description: Duration-heavy stealth build. Stay invisible, pick targets, vanish before anyone notices.
playstyle: Go invisible, line up finishers on priority targets. Duration keeps you ghosted between kills.

name: Dagath — Doom Bringer
description: Max out Dagath's doom-spreading. Enemies die slow, then all at once — deeply satisfying.
playstyle: Spread doom with abilities, let DoTs tick. Strength and duration both matter here.

name: Qorvex — Radiation Fortress
description: Unkillable radiation tank. Stand in the fire, laugh, irradiate everything around you.
playstyle: Stack armor and health. Your presence alone melts crowds with radiation procs.

name: Gyre — Electric Cascade
description: Crit-electric Gyre that chains lightning across the whole tileset. Enemies don't get to move.
playstyle: Keep Cathode Grace active for crit. Cast into groups — the arcs do the rest.

name: Voruna — Pack Hunter Melee
description: Melee-focused Voruna that hunts in a blur. Leap in, shred, leap out — the pack never stops.
playstyle: Use Ulfrun's Descent to gap-close. Melee with high status to proc everything, constantly moving.

mods.name: Equilibrium
mods.note: Orbs from Lycath's Hunt convert health to energy and back — endless fuel for the pack.

name: Citrine — Crystal Guardian
description: The support build every squad wants. Crystals for DR, healing, and buffs — you keep everyone alive.
playstyle: Keep crystals up at all times. High duration = less recasting. Position centrally so the squad stays in range.

name: Kullervo — Heavy Attack Monster
description: The one-shot melee king. Stack combo, heavy attack, watch Steel Path heavies evaporate.
playstyle: Build combo with light attacks, then heavy attack everything. Wrathful Advance teleports you to the next victim.

name: Nova Prime — Unkillable Nuke
description: The ultimate Nova: 90% damage reduction from Null Star plus max-strength Molecular Prime that slows everything 75% and makes enemies explode into each other. Unkillable and room-clearing.
playstyle: Keep Null Star up at all times for 90% DR. Cast Molecular Prime into groups — primed enemies take double damage and chain-explode. Antimatter Drop for single-target burst.

mods.name: Primed Continuity
mods.note: Duration — keeps Null Star particles alive

name: Shedu — Steel Path Shredder
description: Viral + slash meta Shedu that melts Steel Path. Viral halves HP, slash bleeds through armor, AoE pulse groups enemies.
playstyle: Fire into groups — the empty-mag AoE pulse clusters enemies. Viral procs halve HP, Hunter Munitions slash finishes through armor.

name: Nautilus Prime — Best Sentinel Setup
description: The ultimate support sentinel: vacuum, auto-revive, energy orbs, and frost priming for Condition Overload.
playstyle: Set and forget. Vacuum grabs loot, Guardian saves you from death, Verglas primes enemies with cold.

name: Burst Laser Prime — Steel Path Shredder
description: Burst-fire crit monster. Viral melts Steel Path — each burst stacks procs fast.
playstyle: Aim for heads — the burst fires tight. Viral-weakened targets burst down fast. Reload is fast, keep firing.

mods.name: Galvanized Shot
mods.note: Damage + status chance that stacks on kill

name: Tenet Grigori — Max Damage
description: Combo-scaling monster. At 12x combo: 720% bonus crit, 440% bonus status, Condition Overload multiplying everything. Millions per swing.
playstyle: Build combo with light attacks — never heavy attack (resets combo). Use Naramon focus so combo doesn't decay. At high combo, everything dies in one hit.

mods.name: Blood Rush
mods.note: Crit scales with combo — the big one

name: Felarx — Steel Path Destroyer
description: One of the strongest shotguns in the game. Devastating Attrition evolution makes non-crits hit for +2000%. Viral + slash deletes everything.
playstyle: Evolve with Devastating Attrition. Aim for heads — crits proc slash, non-crits get the massive evolution bonus. Works at any range.

name: Volt + Rubico Prime — Eidolon Hunter (Hydrolyst)
description: Strong Eidolon hunter setup. Volt's shield boosts crit damage and Rubico Prime lands precise shots on weak points. Radiation + Cold is the established Eidolon element mix. (Weapon half — the paired Volt build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Drop Volt's Shield near the Eidolon and shoot through it — the shield's crit multiplier applies at the end of the damage calculation. Aim for the glowing weak points (synovia), then the head after the last limb breaks. Use an Operator amp to break shields. Equip the elemental mods in the listed order (Heat, then Electricity, then Cold) so they combine into Radiation + Cold — Cold + Electricity first would make Magnetic instead and cost a large share of your damage. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.

mods.name: Stormbringer
mods.note: Electricity, equip second: Heat + Electricity = Radiation

name: Citrine + Nataruk — Archon Hunt Killer
description: Strong Archon Hunt setup. Nataruk's perfect-shot arrows punch through Archon damage reduction, and Citrine keeps the squad alive through the long fight. Radiation is the established Archon element. (Weapon half — the paired Citrine build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Charge Nataruk and release just before full charge for a perfect shot — the timing window is the weapon's core mechanic. Do NOT mod fire rate: it shrinks the perfect-shot window. Archon Hunts have no revives, so stay near Citrine's crystals and keep her buffs up. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.

mods.name: Stormbringer
mods.note: Electricity, equip second: Heat + Electricity = Radiation

name: Chroma + Mausolon — Profit-Taker Orb Killer
description: Strong Profit-Taker setup. Chroma's Vex Armor multiplies weapon damage and Mausolon is one of the strongest Archguns for the fight, with good ammo economy. Radiation for the Orb's Alloy Armor. (Weapon half — the paired Chroma build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Cycle through the Orb's shield phases, matching the damage type each phase is weak to — the fight requires broad damage-type coverage, so bring a varied loadout. Keep Vex Armor up for the damage buff and drop Effigy before the Orb dies to double the credit reward. Mausolon takes no arcane. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize. Alternative for the pylon phase: a piercing weapon such as Opticor Vandal.

mods.name: Primed Electrified Barrel

name: Wisp + Opticor Vandal — Exploiter Orb Killer
description: Strong Exploiter Orb setup. The fight is mechanic-driven, not a damage race — Wisp's motes cover speed, healing, and crowd control while Opticor Vandal hits the vents and engine hard. Radiation for Alloy Armor. (Weapon half — the paired Wisp build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Deposit Diluted Thermia in the Deck 12 condenser, then thaw the four frozen heat vents by throwing Condensed Thermia Canisters at them and shoot them. In phase 2, overheat her by throwing Thermia canisters (Coolant Raknoids try to cool her), then shoot the exposed engine. After she dies, loot fast — she self-destructs with a wide blast. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.

name: Rhino + Vectis Prime — Ropalolyst Killer
description: Strong Ropalolyst setup. Rhino's Roar buffs weapon damage and Iron Skin covers survivability; Vectis Prime's single heavy shots are built for the Synovia weak points. Radiation is the most effective element against the Ropalolyst. (Weapon half — the paired Rhino build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Use your Operator amp to break the Ropalolyst's shields, ram it into a charged capacitor, shoot a Synovia to stun it, then hit the console for the Terren Charger beam. Repeat three times. Keep Roar up and Iron Skin refreshed — the Ropalolyst can disrupt abilities, so keep shields up. Vectis Prime's one-round magazine means every shot is a first shot, so Charged Chamber applies to all of them. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.

name: Revenant + Phenmor — Lich & Sister Killer
description: Strong setup for Acolytes, Kuva Liches, and Sisters of Parvos. Revenant's Mesmer Skin blocks their heavy hits while Phenmor's incarnon minigun form melts tanky targets. Radiation for Alloy Armor. (Weapon half — the paired Revenant build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Keep Mesmer Skin up — its charges absorb heavy Lich, Sister, and Acolyte hits. Charge Phenmor's incarnon form with headshots on adds, then switch to the alt-fire minigun form on the Lich or Sister. Swap Primed Bane of Grineer for Primed Bane of Corpus against Sisters (they are Corpus). Acolytes have heavy damage reduction — burst them down in incarnon form. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.

name: Dante + Kuva Hek — Murmur & Fragmented Killer
description: Strong setup for Murmur endgame bosses, including The Fragmented. Kuva Hek's Radiation + Cold loadout is the community-established Murmur combination, and Dante's Overguard keeps you standing through attacks that can one-shot. (Weapon half — the paired Dante build is a separate entry in this library.)
playstyle: Collect Murmur Eyes to summon the boss (30 for the standard fight, 60 for the superboss version). Watch for the Fragmented's headshot weakspots — glowing teal spheres revealed during Seeking Missiles — and aim for them. The boss stacks a soft-enrage debuff over time, so armor-strip from a separate weapon or ability helps. Do NOT run Viral or Hunter Munitions here: Murmur resists Viral, so they waste slots.

name: Rhino + Laetum — General Steel Path Boss Killer
description: Strong general-purpose Steel Path boss-killer for tough single targets. Laetum's Devouring Attrition evolution gives non-critical hits a large damage bonus, and Rhino's Roar is pure damage with no crit buff — so it never fights the evolution. (Weapon half — the paired Rhino frame build is the shared "Rhino — Boss-Killer Frame" entry in this library.)
playstyle: Charge Laetum's incarnon form with headshots, then switch to the alt-fire grenade-launcher form on the boss. Do NOT mod crit on this build: crit mods reduce the value of Devouring Attrition, which pays off on non-critical hits. Likewise, avoid frames that buff crit — Citrine is a poor pick here — while Rhino's Roar is pure damage and safe. Modded elements give Corrosive (Toxin + Electricity) plus Heat; the incarnon form adds innate Radiation. If you aim for heads consistently, the crit variant (Overwhelming Attrition) is the alternative. Frame arcane: Arcane Energize.
